reuse.why: Keeps using getNextDate and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but writes the new 'daily schedules skip weekends' rule separately at each site instead of adding a shared predicate or skip helper in shared/schedules.ts.

duplication.why: The condition skipWeekend && frequency === 'daily' is written three times (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, schedule-template), and the 'take 7 and drop weekend occurrences' search is written twice.

placement.why: The core rule is correctly added to shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, but server/schedules/app.ts and budget/schedule-template.ts each re-decide it locally.

scope.why: Only the schedule date sites, the recur data passed through parseRecurDate and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Three differently shaped versions of the same rule (movesWeekend, skipDaily, inline check) with magic 7s must be kept in sync, and schedule-template reads frequency through schedule?.data?.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction for the daily rule was present to bypass; the sites still route weekend moves through getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip condition appears as movesWeekend in budget/schedule-template.ts, skipDaily in server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and an inline condition in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, each reshaped and renamed.

one_place.where: The rule is decided in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, again in server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates (skipDaily filter) and again in server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList (movesWeekend).
